title: Ali Ne Khilona Nahi Diya! 😢 | Bhai-Behan Mein Sharing | Islamic Cartoon for Kids
description:
Abbu ne Ali ko nayi gaadi di, lekin Ali ne Zara ko khelne nahi diya! 😢 Phir Dadu ne kya sikhaya? Dekhiye Ali aur Zara ki pyaari kahani. 🤲

📖 Hadith:
Anas ibn Malik (RA) se riwayat hai ki Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya:
"Tum mein se koi tab tak (kaamil) momin nahi ho sakta jab tak woh apne bhai ke liye wahi pasand na kare jo apne liye pasand karta hai."
— Sahih Bukhari 13, Sahih Muslim 45 (Sahih)

✅ Apne bhai-behan ke saath share karo
✅ Jo apne liye pasand ho, wahi doosron ke liye bhi pasand karo

Apne bachchon ke saath zaroor dekhein. Roz nayi kahani — Hidayah ko subscribe karein ❤️
